flow.name: put:\tickets\(PNR)\checkin:application\json:api-config
flow.doc:description: Handles PUT /tickets/{PNR}/checkin with a dummy PayPal payment ID response.

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Message
ee:transform.doc:description: Stores the PNR path parameter in a variable for the check-in flow.

ee:variables.doc:description: Defines variables assigned by the check-in transform.

ee:set-variable.doc:description: Saves the PNR URI parameter as the PNR flow variable.

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Message
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets the dummy check-in response payload.

ee:message.doc:description: Defines the payload returned by the check-in operation.

ee:set-payload.doc:description: Returns a sample PayPal payment ID as JSON.

flow.name: put:\tickets\(PNR)\paymentApproval:application\json:api-config
flow.doc:description: Handles PUT /tickets/{PNR}/paymentApproval with a dummy boarding pass response.

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Message
ee:transform.doc:description: Stores the PNR path parameter in a variable for the payment approval flow.

ee:variables.doc:description: Defines variables assigned by the payment approval transform.

ee:set-variable.doc:description: Saves the PNR URI parameter as the PNR flow variable.

ee:transform.doc:name: Transform Message
ee:transform.doc:description: Sets the dummy boarding pass payload for the payment approval operation.

ee:message.doc:description: Defines the boarding pass payload returned after payment approval.

ee:set-payload.doc:description: Returns a sample boarding pass as JSON.

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { lastName: "Smith", flightDate: "2019-02-14", depart: "14:30:00", boarding: "13:15:00", gate: "4A", flight: "ANY6584", airportDepart: "ATL", airportArrive: "SFO", class: "Economy", seat: "16C", bagsCount: 2, PNR: "928382J" } as Object {encoding: "UTF-8", mediaType: "application/json"}
